# Buccaneer

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/gui/icons/buccaneer.png){ .entry-page-icon }

[Races](index.md) · [Race Race no Mi](../../reference/content/racenomi.md)

Broad, Stout and Great are cosmetic choices with the same body size, passive and moves. Sneak to hunch through ordinary doorways.

## Answering Fist

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/abilities/answering_fist.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user punches the enemy in front of them and throws them far. The more the user was hurt in the last seconds the harder it hits, up to twice

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| --- | --- |
| Base damage | 10 HP |
| Cooldown | 15 s (300 ticks) |
| Conditional cooldown | 0.5 s (10 ticks) |

</div>

## Buccaneer Charge

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/abilities/buccaneer_charge.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user rushes a few blocks ahead shoulder first and knocks over every enemy on the way Blocks are not broken, a wall stops the rush. Only works standing up A huge open palm is thrust ahead on the spot. Every enemy before it is hit and thrown far back

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base damage | 7 HP |
| Cooldown | 10 s (200 ticks) |
| Palm damage | 10 HP |
| Palm cooldown | 8 s (160 ticks) |

</div>

## Crushing Hold

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/abilities/crushing_hold.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

## Living Wall

![](../../assets/playable/racenomi/abilities/living_wall.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user stands as a wall of flesh for a few seconds. Blows from the front at allies behind them hit the user instead, and the user takes half of them and is not pushed Used again the wall comes down
